The screen is complete: `src/screens/Screen.tsx` (default export) with `src/screens/Screen.module.css`.

- **Photo**: circular avatar with initials fallback, "Change photo" (file picker → local preview) and "Remove photo".
- **Fields**: full name, email, phone, date of birth, preferred language (select), each showing an "Edited" badge when it differs from the last-saved mock data.
- **Change tracking**: draft state is diffed against the saved snapshot; unsaved-changes text appears above the actions, and Save/Cancel are disabled when nothing changed.
- **Save flow**: Save simulates an async save, then shows "Profile saved." (via `aria-live="polite"`); Cancel reverts the draft to the last saved values.
- Styled with logical CSS properties and Strata token `var()`s with sensible fallbacks (no `@strata/react` component imports, since `node_modules` isn't installed in this snapshot and I couldn't verify its API), so it should theme correctly across brands, light/dark, and the Arabic RTL locale.
